This is your step-by-step guide to participating in the Johnnies Day Food Trail. Here’s how to enter: 1️⃣ Visit participating Food Trail locations across NYC and Long Island and beyond between February 15 – February 21. 2️⃣ Select locations offering special Johnnies Day Menu Items and/or a discount with your storm card. 3️⃣ Scan the unique QR code at each location to check-in. For bonus entries: 4️⃣ Share your visit on social media, tagging @StJohnsU and the restaurant you’re visiting. 5️⃣ Use #JDFoodTrail and #JohnniesDay. (Only posts from public accounts will be counted.) 💥 Entries count once per day, per location, per participant. Visit as many stops as you want throughout the week to boost your chances. 🏆 The participant with the most check-ins will win the ultimate prize pack: • Two tickets to MBB vs. Villanova (2/28) • Access to an exclusive pre-game reception • St. John’s backpack, scarf, hat, and executive SJU pen Winners will be notified by Wednesday, February 25.
